title: Top 15 Guesty Integrations for Vacation Rental Property Managers
summary: What the top Guesty integrations do and how each connects to Guesty, from PriceLabs and Breezeway to smart locks, screening and owner charges.
body_markdown:
Updated November 2026


Guesty is your property management software. But plenty of the work around each stay happens somewhere else. Someone sets the price, cleans the unit and sends the door code. Someone screens the guest and makes sure the supply run lands on the right owner's statement.


When those tools don't connect to Guesty, your team becomes the manual connection.


Guesty integrations fix that. The Guesty Marketplace lets you plug specialist tools straight into your account, so every tool works from the same bookings in Guesty.


Each of the 15 integrations below is listed in the Guesty Marketplace, is widely used by professional property managers, and handles a core job. The numbers are reading order, not a ranking. All of them are strong options, and they work well side by side.


## Finance and Accounting


Owner funds and company books both have to be right, and they have to stay separate.


### 1. Topkey


Topkey is the AI-powered financial operating system built specifically for vacation rental managers. Integrating directly into Guesty and your accounting software, Topkey provides a single, unified system that automates expenses, bookkeeping, receipts, banking, corporate cards, AP/bill pay, inventory, revenue reconciliation, trust accounting and owner statements, so you can get back to what matters: hospitality. Day to day, it's where card and bank expenses, receipts, work orders, bills and vendor payments come together, with every expense tied to a property. It's available in the Guesty Marketplace.


How it works with Guesty.


Topkey connects to Guesty and your accounting software, so the money behind every property runs through one place:


- Expenses and receipts.


Corporate card and bank transactions are matched to receipts and tagged to the right Guesty property, and that detail carries into QuickBooks or Xero for per-property reporting.


- Owner charges.


One click posts an expense to Guesty as an owner charge with the receipt attached, and supplies checked out from inventory are tied to the right owner with your markup applied.


- Payments.


Vendor bills get paid in bulk by ACH or check, and if you use Guesty Accounting, every owner gets paid in one ACH batch.


- Revenue.


Topkey's


[revenue reconciliation tool](https://topkey.io/revenue-reconciliation)


, RevHub, matches OTA payouts and bank deposits to your Guesty reservations, so you can see what each booking should have paid against what actually landed.


Why it helps.


Expenses, bills, owner charges, inventory, payouts, and deposits stop living in separate spreadsheets, and every dollar ties back to a property and an owner. Month-end close goes from days to hours, your team saves at least 25 hours a month, and owner billables go up 15% to 20%.


[Visit Topkey](https://topkey.io/integrations/guesty)


### 2. QuickBooks Online


QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud accounting software. Many Guesty property managers keep their company books in it: the general ledger, the P&L and the financial reports.


How it works with Guesty.


Through the Guesty Connect add-on, reservations, payments and fees flow from Guesty into QuickBooks, and purchases recorded in QuickBooks can come into Guesty as expenses. Guesty also lists a Zapier connection and partner-built options for other workflows.


Why it helps.


Guesty Accounting can handle the trust side, meaning owner money and owner statements, while QuickBooks keeps your company's own books. The connection keeps the two in step, so owner funds stay separate from your company's money without anything being entered twice.


[Visit QuickBooks Online](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/)


## Pricing and Revenue


Nightly rates should move with demand. PriceLabs and Wheelhouse both handle that, in different ways.


### 3. PriceLabs


PriceLabs is a dynamic pricing and revenue management platform for short-term rentals. It sets nightly rates and minimum stays based on market demand, seasonality and your own rules.


How it works with Guesty.


You connect PriceLabs from the Guesty Marketplace. It imports your Guesty listings and pricing history, then pushes updated nightly rates and minimum nights back into Guesty. Prices update every 24 hours by default, and you can sync more often.


Why it helps.


Your rates keep up with demand on their own, so busy nights aren't underpriced and nobody edits listings one by one. It suits managers who want detailed control over rates and minimum stays.


[Visit PriceLabs](https://hello.pricelabs.co/)


### 4. Wheelhouse


Wheelhouse is a revenue management platform for professional operators. Along with dynamic pricing, it offers A/B testing, pacing reports, comp sets and market reports.


How it works with Guesty.


You connect Wheelhouse from the Guesty Marketplace with a Guesty API key. It syncs your listings, reservations and pricing from Guesty, then sends its prices back once you turn on Wheelhouse Pricing. If you ever turn it off, Wheelhouse restores the daily prices you had before connecting.


Why it helps.


You can try pricing strategies side by side and see which one earns more. It tends to appeal to revenue managers who like to experiment.


[Visit Wheelhouse](https://www.usewheelhouse.com/integrations/guesty)


## Operations and Housekeeping


These two make sure every turnover gets cleaned, checked and fixed.


### 5. Breezeway


Breezeway is a property care and operations platform for vacation rental managers. It schedules and tracks cleaning, inspections and maintenance, with checklists and photo proof from the field.


How it works with Guesty.


Breezeway pulls in your Guesty reservations, so tasks are scheduled around each stay and linked to the booking they belong to.


Why it helps.


Your field team always knows what needs doing and when, so a same-day turnover doesn't get missed. In-house operations teams get the most out of it.


[Visit Breezeway](https://www.breezeway.io/)


### 6. Turno


Turno is cleaning scheduling software with a marketplace of local cleaners. It schedules your existing cleaners automatically and helps you find new ones nearby.


How it works with Guesty.


Turno imports your Guesty listings and reservations so every checkout gets a cleaning on the schedule. When the cleaning is done, Turno lets Guesty know.


Why it helps.


Every checkout gets a cleaning on the calendar automatically, and a backup cleaner is a few taps away when someone cancels. It's a strong fit if you rely on independent cleaners.


[Visit Turno](https://turno.com/)


## Guest Experience


Check-in, guest messages and repeat bookings all run through this group.


### 7. Enso Connect


Enso Connect is a guest experience platform for vacation rentals and boutique hotels. It automates guest messaging, digital check-in and upsells through a web-based guest app.


How it works with Guesty.


Enso connects through Guesty's official API. Listings, bookings, guests and messages sync both ways, with Guesty as the main record.


Why it helps.


Guests get an easier arrival and more ways to add to their stay, which means more revenue per booking. Choose it if upsells and a branded guest app matter as much to you as messaging.


[Visit Enso Connect](https://ensoconnect.com/guesty)


### 8. Duve


Duve is a guest experience platform used by hotels and vacation rentals. It runs online check-in, a branded web guest app and personalized upsells.


How it works with Guesty.


The two-way integration brings Guesty reservations into Duve automatically. Duve then updates Guesty with the guest details it collects and any orders guests place.


Why it helps.


You know who's arriving before they reach the door, and the extras they buy are recorded in Guesty automatically. It works especially well for teams that also run hotel rooms.


[Visit Duve](https://duve.com/)


### 9. StayFi


StayFi is guest Wi-Fi and marketing software built for short-term rentals. Guests log in to Wi-Fi through a branded page that captures their name, email and phone number, and StayFi runs email and text marketing from there.


How it works with Guesty.


StayFi imports your Guesty properties and contacts and reads reservation details. The guest contacts it collects flow back into Guesty.


Why it helps.


You build a list of past guests you can invite back to book direct, including people who first found you on Airbnb or Vrbo.


[Visit StayFi](https://stayfi.com/)


## Access and Monitoring


These three control who gets in and what happens once they're inside.


### 10. RemoteLock


RemoteLock is access control software that works with many smart lock brands. It creates unique, self-expiring access codes for guests and staff.


How it works with Guesty.


RemoteLock uses your Guesty reservations to issue a code for each stay automatically.


Why it helps.


No lockboxes or key handoffs, and every code stops working when the stay ends. RemoteLock makes the most sense when your portfolio runs a mix of lock brands.


[Visit RemoteLock](https://remotelock.com/)


### 11. PointCentral


PointCentral is smart home automation for vacation rental portfolios. It manages locks, thermostats and other connected devices across many properties.


How it works with Guesty.


PointCentral assigns access codes automatically for guests and maintenance staff, based on Guesty reservations.


Why it helps.


Guests and maintenance staff go straight to the door with their own code, with no key pickup. Consider it if you want locks and thermostats managed together.


[Visit PointCentral](https://www.pointcentral.com/)


### 12. Minut


Minut makes noise, occupancy and smoke monitoring for rentals. It measures decibel levels only and never records audio, and it alerts you when noise or crowding passes the limits you set.


How it works with Guesty.


Minut reads your listings from Guesty. When noise runs high, it can message the guest automatically through the Guesty Inbox or by text.


Why it helps.


You can stop a party early, before neighbors complain or damage happens. It's especially worth it in markets where noise complaints are a real risk.


[Visit Minut](https://www.minut.com/integrations/guesty)


## Screening and Protection


Screening catches risky bookings before arrival, and protection covers the damage if something still goes wrong.


### 13. Truvi


Truvi is a risk management platform for short-term rentals that handles guest screening, identity verification and damage protection.


How it works with Guesty.


Truvi connects to Guesty, so screening runs on your Guesty reservations without the guest having to do anything. Damage protection applies to the bookings Truvi has screened.


Why it helps.


Risky bookings get flagged before guests arrive, and damage protection covers the stay without collecting a deposit.


[Visit Truvi](https://truvi.com/)


### 14. Autohost


Autohost is an AI guest screening platform for short-term rentals, and Guesty was its first PMS integration. It scans reservations for fraud and risk, verifies IDs and gives your team a list of action items.


How it works with Guesty.


Autohost processes Guesty reservations as they come in, and screening results show up on the reservation inside Guesty.


Why it helps.


Your team only reviews the few bookings that look risky, instead of checking every guest by hand.


[Visit Autohost](https://www.autohost.ai/)


### 15. Safely


Safely is a short-term rental insurance specialist. Its Damage Waiver protects against damage guests cause during a stay, and it offers guest verification too.


How it works with Guesty.


You connect Safely from the Guesty Marketplace, and its billing appears on your monthly Guesty invoice.


Why it helps.


Each stay is protected without asking guests for a big security deposit. Guesty also has its own Damage Protection add-on, so compare the two.


[Visit Safely](https://safely.com/)


## How These Integrations Fit Together


Follow one booking from start to finish. PriceLabs set the nightly rate that won it. Autohost cleared the guest the moment the reservation landed. RemoteLock sent a code that works only for those dates. Breezeway scheduled the clean for checkout morning. Minut kept the second night quiet. And when the cleaner grabbed extra linens on the way, Topkey put that purchase on the owner's statement in Guesty with the receipt attached.


No one copied a reservation from one system to another. The booking lived in Guesty, and every tool worked from it.


You'll find every integration in this guide inside Guesty under Integrations, then Marketplace. Most connect with an API key you copy from Guesty.


## Guesty Integrations FAQ


### What are Guesty integrations?


Guesty integrations are third-party tools that connect to your Guesty account through the Guesty Marketplace or Guesty's API. They share reservation, listing and guest data with Guesty, so nobody has to move it by hand.


### Where do I find Guesty integrations?


In your Guesty account, go to Integrations, then Marketplace. Most tools connect when you copy an API key from Guesty into the partner's app.


### Does Guesty integrate with QuickBooks Online?


Yes. Guesty connects QuickBooks to Guesty Accounting through the Guesty Connect add-on. Zapier and partner-built options cover other workflows.


### Can I bill owners for expenses in Guesty?


Yes. Guesty records owner charges on owner statements. Expense tools like Topkey send charges to Guesty with the receipt attached, so they don't have to be entered by hand.


### What smart locks work with Guesty?


RemoteLock and PointCentral are two widely used options in the Guesty Marketplace. Guesty also has its own Locks Manager for supported lock brands.


### How do I prevent parties in a Guesty rental?


Pair guest screening, such as Truvi or Autohost, with noise monitoring, such as Minut. Screening catches risky bookings before arrival, and monitoring catches noise during the stay.
